d: A tragic head-on collision between a truck and a passenger Traveller vehicle in Rongajan, Kaziranga, Assam, has left more than 20 people feared dead. The mini-bus, carrying mostly students, was travelling from Bokakhat to Nagaon when the devastating crash occurred. Several passengers remain trapped inside the mangled vehicle as local residents and police carry out rescue operations, while the injured have been rushed to Kohora Model Hospital for urgent medical treatment.
